paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the Senior Multimedia Specialist position at MEM. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

Your posting asks for someone to lead your video and digital work. I have done that work since 2019. I plan, script, shoot, light, and edit. At Grand Canyon Education, I delivered 200+ videos over two years reaching millions on TV, paid social, and organic channels. At Charter One, I led video initiatives that drove paid and organic engagement by over 100%.

I run my own production company, Lightbox Digital. I take each project from concept through final delivery, and I delivered 98% of projects on-time and 92% within budget. In 2024, MEM and Previsor became one brand. I can make each photo and video fit that brand. Your posting also asks for someone to track new media. I use Kling, Runway, Midjourney, and Google Veo for a complete AI video workflow. My portfolio and demo reel at the top of this page show my work.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.

posting_capture.jd_text:
> **How much is verbatim:** Partial. No source showed the full posting, and I could not find MEM's own careers page. About eight short fragments below are verbatim: they appeared in quotation marks in search snippets, or in the snippets the brief already had. Everything marked [paraphrase] is reworded text from a search summary. Lines marked [near-verbatim] are summary text that reads like posting wording but was not shown in quotation marks. The order of the bullets is my best reconstruction. It is not confirmed.

# Senior Multimedia Specialist
**MEM (MEM Mutual Insurance Company / "MEM Insurance")** - Marketing team
Full-time | $67,200 - $100,800 a year | Iowa - Remote (Indeed); Columbia, MO, On-site (ZipRecruiter); Remote and Kansas City, MO (Glassdoor); Chicago, IL (Mediabistro, mislabeled as "RiseMe")

## Overview
"MEM Insurance is seeking a Sr. Multimedia Specialist to join our Marketing team… In this role, you will lead the creation of impactful multimedia marketing assets across digital, video, print, and emerging media channels. You will combine creative vision with hands-on execution" **[verbatim; the snippet stops after "execution"]**

## Responsibilities
- [paraphrase] Lead the development of visually compelling marketing assets that strengthen MEM's brand.
- [paraphrase] Provide creative guidance and visual direction, advising on creative choices.
- "...research and evaluate emerging multimedia trends, technologies, and formats..." **[verbatim fragment]**
- [paraphrase] Produce content across digital, video, and print channels.
- "...independently manage multimedia projects from concept through final delivery..." **[verbatim fragment]**
- [paraphrase] Manage external creative vendors and partners.
- "...review and approve marketing assets for brand consistency, accessibility..." **[verbatim fragment]** [paraphrase of the rest: "...accuracy, and overall quality before release"]
- [paraphrase] Maintain version control and distribution of marketing assets across platforms. (The summary's wording, "version control, and distribution of", suggests the original is a three-item list.)
- [paraphrase] Collaborate with cross-functional teams.

## Qualifications

### Education
- "Bachelor's degree in Graphic Arts, Emerging Media, Marketing, Creative Arts, or a related field required." **[verbatim]**

### Experience
- [near-verbatim, from summary] 7+ years of progressive experience in multimedia, creative production, visual marketing, or a related field.
- [near-verbatim, from summary] 4+ years of experience supporting B2B and/or B2C marketing initiatives.
- "5+ years of experience working with multimedia, marketing, and creative production tools and platforms" **[verbatim fragment, from the snippets the brief already had]**
  - Note: two summaries attribute the 7+ years requirement to the Mediabistro/RiseMe copy and the Glassdoor Remote copy. The 5+ years "tools and platforms" line could be a separate tools requirement in the same posting, or it could come from a different version of the posting. I could not tell which.

### Certifications and Portfolio
- "Professional multimedia portfolio required." **[verbatim; "Certifications and Portfolio" is the section heading as it appeared in the snippet]**

### Other
- [paraphrase] Valid driver's license required. (Two separate summaries said this, for the Mediabistro copy and the Glassdoor Remote copy.)

## Benefits
- [near-verbatim, from summary] Generous PTO
- [near-verbatim, from summary] 11 Holidays + 4 Early Releases
- [near-verbatim, from summary] 401k with an employer match and profit sharing
- ZipRecruiter benefit tags: Medical, Vision, Dental, Paid time off, Life insurance, Retirement

## Sections not found in any source
- A preferred qualifications section. None surfaced.
- A list of software or tools. One summary said the MEM excerpts "don't mention Adobe at all".
- Any wording on remote eligibility or which states remote employees may live in.
- An About MEM paragraph or an EEO statement. One summary described MEM as "owned by its policyholders rather than stockholders, and governed by a Board of Directors", but it may come from Glassdoor's company overview rather than the posting.
- Travel percentage and reporting line.

## Posting date
ZipRecruiter showed the Columbia, MO listing as 14 days old on 2026-10-23, so it was posted around 2026-10-09.
